ThemeTypography, ThemeSpacing, ThemeRadius, ThemeColor are global singletons.

Every component uses Theme tokens for font/spacing/color.

DESIGN SPEC - Navigation pattern
Root app container uses `TabView` equivalent with three root tabs: Study, Stats, Settings & Tools.
Navigation is stack-based inside each tab.
Study:
- Deck List as root.
- Deck Detail pushed from deck row.
- Card Editor opens as sheet from Deck Detail and supports Save & Add Another.
- Review Session opens from deck row or Study All CTA.
- Session Summary sheet is only reachable after complete queue.
Stats:
- Stats Overview root.
- Drill-down per-deck stats via navigation push.
Settings & Tools:
- Root with grouped rows:
  - CSV Export
  - CSV Import
  - Reminders
  - Demo Data
  - Plan & Subscription
  - Gap & Limitations
  - About / Run instructions
CSV Import and gap states use sheets for long tasks.
No disabled affordances for non-goals anywhere.

DESIGN SPEC - Screen states and behavior

Study / Deck List
Copy hierarchy: top summary strip, quick actions, deck list.
Primary components: DueDeckCard + Search/Filter bar + Study All row + floating add button.
States:
Loading: animated placeholder deck cards and “loading your study library” meta text, retry action disabled.
Empty: icon `tray.2`, title “No decks yet,” body “Create a deck to start reviews,” action “Create deck.”
All caught up: icon `checkmark.seal`, title “All caught up,” body “You have decks, none are due today,” action “Review all later.”
Success: deck cards sorted by due descending then name.
Error: icon `exclamationmark.triangle`, body “Couldn’t load decks,” action “Try again.”
If user is over cap, show inline non-blocking cap notice row, not blocking study launch.

Deck Detail
Hierarchy: deck metadata, counts, action lane, card list.
States:
Loading: skeleton items.
Empty deck: title “No cards yet,” body “Add your first card,” action “Add card.”
Success: card rows with fast-edit affordance.
Archived mode: section toggled by filter; archived cards visible but visually de-emphasized.
Error: inline recoverable message + retry.

Card Editor
Hierarchy: front field, back field, optional note field, Save actions.
States:
Idle: clean editor with front focused.
Typing: validation strip below optional fields (front/back required).
Saving: disable destructive actions, spinner in Save button.
Saved/commit confirmation: inline check text “Card saved” visible in sheet header region only; no toast.
Error: inline inline text from validation; retry stays on same screen.

Review Session
Hierarchy: progress counter, card stack panel, reveal state, grading staircase.
States:
Ready: deck/due scope preloaded; first card front visible.
Revealing: answer enters with fast settle animation.
Grading: staircase row visible and stable at bottom.
Saving: explicit save-state lock after grade press until DB commit returns.
Interrupted resume: restore progress and next due card on re-open.
Completed: session summary.
Cap-hit mid-session: persistent non-blocking inline banner at top of action lane, does not block grading.
Cancel/End Session: explicit, honest control that marks session as interrupted.

Session Summary
Reachability: only after completed session.
Success state: cardsReviewed, againRate, elapsedTime, deck scope.
Error fallback: none; on summary render failure, return to study list with inline session interruption copy.

Stats / Overview
Hierarchy: forecast chart top, daily history row, retention card, drill-down link.
States:
Loading: placeholder bars.
Empty: “No review history yet,” action “Start first review.”
Sparse: show minimal values with “Insufficient data for trend” callout and action “Review 10 more cards.”
Success: 30-day forecast, history, retention computed from real logs, no fabricated flat baselines.
Error: retry plus last-known safe state note.

Stats / Deck Drill-down
Hierarchy: selected deck scope header + same three charts.
States:
No deck selected: inline action to pick deck from list.
Deck with no history: sparse/empty state above.
Success: scoped metrics with due forecast and retention.

CSV Export
Hierarchy: deck picker, file naming row, export action.
States:
Idle: select deck.
Exporting: progress with indeterminate activity.
Success: completion banner with saved-file location and share action.
Permission-unavailable: action text to open Files app docs path, no crash.

CSV Import
Hierarchy: file picker, parser state, row-preview table, commit action.
States:
FilePicked: parse status visible.
Parsing: spinner + “validating rows.”
Preview: each row has status chip from:
valid, empty front/back, wrong columns, quote/line parse issue, encoding/BOM issue, duplicate, plan-cap-blocked.
CommitPending: confirm to import.
Importing: blocked commit lock + spinner.
Completed: count imported, count failed, list of reasons still shown.
Error: parse-level message + pick another file.

Reminders
Hierarchy: master toggle, permission state card, due-time picker, per-deck override section.
States:
Not requested: action to trigger permission prompt.
Granted: scheduler settings + last refresh state.
Denied: non-blocking explanatory text + path-to-Settings.
Per-deck override available for Plus only; Free users see upgrade path without blocking reminders.

Demo Data
States:
Off: action “Enable demo data.”
On: two seeded decks tagged as demo across relevant screens.
Turn-off: explicit confirmation and zero-residue wording; once disabled, remove all demo markers from aggregate stats.

Plan / Subscription
States:
Free: show caps and what works free.
Plus: unlock caps and per-deck reminder customization.
Purchase: StoreKit state machine with restore.
Lapse: existing content remains visible; creation locks only.

Gap & Limitations
States:
Loaded static section list with effort notes:
storekit exception, notification staleness without foreground refresh, timezone/due-status flips, iCloud backup divergence, and hard non-goal constraints.
No controls, no fake status indicators.

Settings & Tools root
Simple list with direct actions; no disabled controls for non-goals.
Error surfaces are copy-only with “Open docs” action, never broken switches.

DESIGN SPEC - Motion & Haptics
Tap-to-reveal uses a 180ms settle (duration 0.18) with easeOut and no bounce. No 3D flip.
Card transition: small 4pt translate down to 0 and alpha 0.85→1.0.
Grade buttons animate in from bottom with stagger (12ms delay each, 0.16s total movement), easing `easeOut`.
On reduced motion, this reveal transition is disabled; buttons still appear instantly; haptics still fire.
Haptic sequence:
Again = light impact
Hard = medium impact
Good = rigid
Easy = heavy
Haptics only when device supports; fallback to no-op with no functional change.
Session summary and summary counters animate from 0→target once only on completion using linear short count-up.
Never use persistent “Saved” confirmation for per-card grading; confirmation is structural (stack advances, remaining count decrements).

DESIGN SPEC - Accessibility constraints
Use tabular numerals for all counts.
No icon-only grade buttons are allowed.
Grading controls are staircase shape + position + text labels:
Again “Forgot,” Hard “Stumbled,” Good “Known,” Easy “Confident,” with unique footprint and icon.
VoiceOver labels for every icon-only control must be explicit and include grade context.
Card front/back text must support accessibility sizes; allow card body to scroll and keep action lane fixed in bottom safe area so buttons never move off-screen.
Minimum tap targets 44x44.
Add container labels for charts using summary text (“Forecast: ...”, “Retention: ...”).
All states include localized status announcements: empty, loading, error, complete.
Error and warning states must announce recovery action.

Design language compliance checks for final handoff
No view may use default List/Form chrome where the spec asks for card-style surfaces.
No screen may claim success that has not happened; especially no grade-complete banner/toast.
No out-of-scope feature controls are allowed anywhere.
